functions.name: FAssetTextFilter
GetRawFilterText
functions.docs: Returns the unsanitized and unsplit filter terms

functions.name: SetRawFilterText
functions.docs: Set the Text to be used as the Filter's restrictions

functions.name: GetFilterErrorText
functions.docs: Get the last error returned from lexing or compiling the current filter text

functions.name: SetIncludeClassName
functions.docs: If bIncludeClassName is true, the text filter will include an asset's class name in the search

functions.name: SetIncludeAssetPath
functions.docs: If bIncludeAssetPath is true, the text filter will match against full Asset path

functions.name: GetIncludeAssetPath
functions.docs: Returns the last value set with SetIncludeAssetPath

functions.name: SetIncludeCollectionNames
functions.docs: If bIncludeCollectionNames is true, the text filter will match against collection names as well

functions.name: GetIncludeCollectionNames
functions.docs: Returns the last value set with SetIncludeCollectionNames

functions.name: OnChanged
functions.docs: Delegate to bind for when the effective text filter changes so filtering can be re-run.

functions.name: HandleTextFilterValue
functions.signature: HandleTextFilterValue(Target, In Content Browser Item, In Value, In Text Comparison Mode, Out Is Match)

functions.name: HandleTextFilterKeyValue
functions.signature: HandleTextFilterKeyValue(Target, In Content Browser Item, In Key, In Value, In Comparison Operation, In Text Comparison Mode, Out Is Match)

functions.name: RegisterHandler
functions.docs: Call on your derived instance of IAssetTextFilterHandler to have it participate in asset text filtering.

functions.name: UnregisterHandler
functions.docs: Call on your derived instance of IAssetTextFilterHandler to remove it from asset text filtering.
